name: settlemark-near-settlement-thesis
description: Settlemark research note 01: the NEAR settlement thesis, rebuilt from public data with one command.

scripts.bigquery: sh -c '[ -x .venv/bin/python ] && P=.venv/bin/python || P=python3; $P -m settlemark bigquery all'
scripts.anchor: sh -c '[ -x .venv/bin/python ] && P=.venv/bin/python || P=python3; $P -m settlemark anchor verify'
scripts.serve: sh -c '[ -x .venv/bin/python ] && P=.venv/bin/python || P=python3; echo Open http://localhost:8000 ; $P -m http.server 8000 --directory site'
